text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Oh? There's something fluttering around over there…

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Could it be a fairy? Or a Japanese yokai?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Hehe, I can't believe I finally get to meet one.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Oh… It was just a plastic bag…

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Hm. Environmental issues ought to be a higher priority agenda item in this area.
